profile: Vanda Pharmaceuticals develops and commercializes medicines for patients with unmet medical needs. Its marketed products treat schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder, sleep disorders including Non-24 and Smith-Magenis syndrome, relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, and motion-induced vomiting. The company also has drug candidates and potential additional indications in development for neurological, psychiatric, gastrointestinal, dermatological, ophthalmic, and blood disorders.
